Our food pantry opens three days a week and is run entirely by volunteers from the neighborhood, who sort donations, pack boxes and greet every visitor by name. Anyone who needs food is welcome, with no forms to fill in and no questions asked, and we deliver to people who cannot come in.

The summer meal program feeds children while school is out. It runs at four sites across the county, each one in a park or library close to where families live, and every meal is cooked fresh that morning by our kitchen team.
